turns.question: Does any of this get taxed, and do I still get health insurance?
turns.answer:
The Pension Code does not address whether your pension is taxable or whether you continue to receive health insurance.

Your health-insurance arrangements are separate from the pension provisions in Article 11. Section 11-160.1 addresses payments by the Fund to the City for certain health-care plans, but it does not establish your personal eligibility for continued coverage. [40 ILCS 5/11-160.1] The Code also allows the Board to permit an annuitant to assign part of an annuity or disability benefit to pay premiums for certain hospital or medical plans. [40 ILCS 5/11-223.1] You would need the applicable plan rules and your retirement-fund determination to know whether that option applies to you.

Tax treatment belongs to the IRS; health-insurance eligibility and coverage belong to the City’s HR or benefits office and the applicable plan administrator.
